products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as a provider of trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare sector. The company offers a range of products spanning clinical decision support, clinical data management, enterprise imaging, cardiovascular workflow tools, and real-world evidence solutions. Its clinical decision support product, Micromedex, is positioned as a point-of-care resource for clinicians, while Zelta is described as a cloud-based unified platform for clinical data management and acquisition designed for clinical trials programs. The enterprise imaging suite includes Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, and Merge Workflow Orchestrator, and the cardiovascular-focused Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo received a 2025 Best in KLAS ranking. Truven is offered as a health data analytics and consulting service aimed at business decision-making.

The company's held facts identify it as formerly operating under the name Watson Health, with its current AI and analytics work categorized under healthcare and life sciences AI. Its focus areas include healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and protected health information governance. Customer-cited outcomes on the company's site include an auto-renewal rate improvement from 17% to 80% for MAGI Medicaid, 36,000 hours in time savings, and nearly $1.3 million in cost savings within a single cohort, as well as a claim that access to cleaner data may reduce the timeline for identifying fetal toxicities from ten years to fewer than five.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the held facts for Merative.
